title: Wall Mount Towel Bar 18-Inch Iron Straight Bar | Lavender | Pipeline Collection | Allied Brass
short_title: Wall Mount Towel Bar 18-Inch | Allied Brass, Lavender
description:
Add reliable towel storage with an 18-Inch wall mount towel bar designed for the Pipeline collection’s pipe-fitting look in Lavender, which introduces soft, calming color that adds a touch of unexpected elegance, perfect for creating a spa-like retreat. This straight bar helps keep towels within reach while the wall-mounted installation saves floor space and supports a clean, organized bathroom.

Highlights:
- Lavender transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 19 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Wall mount installation to help maximize usable bathroom space
- Includes towel bar, mounting plates, and color-coordinated mounting hardware
- Limited Lifetime Warranty

Specs:
- Center-to-center: 18 inches
- Bar diameter: 0.75 inch
- Projection: 3.3 inches
- Overall size: 18 in L x 3 in H x 3.3 in W
- Weight capacity: 10 lb
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Assembly required: No
- Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4"
